meta.title: Codex appearance theme
meta.description: Mirrors the Codex desktop appearance: 29 theme presets (Absolutely, Catppuccin, Everforest, GitHub, Gruvbox, Linear, Notion, One, Proof, Tokyo Night and more) with accent, surface, ink, contrast and font controls. Colors are derived with Codex's own three-color algorithm and mapped onto every DSH semantic token; light and dark are remembered separately.
